preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_model_release_candidate_entry_build_snapshot' AND conrelid = 'modeling_model_release_candidate_entry'::regclass

changeSet.comment: Release the per-model active build claim after publication. PUBLISHED candidates remain immutable delivery history, while a later model revision may acquire the same claim for a new build without deleting or rewriting the earlier publication evidence.

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE modeling_model_release_candidate_entry DROP CONSTRAINT ck_model_release_candidate_entry_build_snapshot; ALTER TABLE modeling_model_release_candidate_entry ADD CONSTRAINT ck_model_release_candidate_entry_build_snapshot CHECK ( ( implementation_revision IS NULL AND implementation_checksum IS NULL AND dbt_unique_id IS NULL AND target_identifier IS NULL AND artifact_bundle_checksum IS NULL AND dependency_snapshot_checksum IS NULL AND ( active_claim_key IS NULL OR ( status IN ('DRAFT', 'BUILDING') AND active_claim_key ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' ) ) ) OR ( implementation_id IS NOT NULL AND implementation_revision > 0 AND implementation_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND dbt_unique_id ~ '^model\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$' AND target_identifier ~ '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$' AND artifact_bundle_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND dependency_snapshot_checksum ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND ( (status = 'CANCELLED' AND active_claim_key IS NULL) OR ( status IN ('REJECTED', 'ROLLED_BACK', 'STALE') AND ( active_claim_key IS NULL OR active_claim_key ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' ) ) OR ( status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'REJECTED', 'ROLLED_BACK', 'STALE') AND active_claim_key ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' ) ) ) );
